verses.en: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.pt: SENHOR, quem morará em tua tenda? Quem habitará no monte de tua santidade?
verses.en_web: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> Lord, who may have a resting-place in your tent, a living-place on your holy hill?

verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.pt: Aquele que anda sinceramente, e pratica a justiça; e com seu coração fala a verdade;
verses.en_web: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.en_bbe: He who goes on his way uprightly, doing righteousness, and saying what is true in his heart;

verses.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.pt: Aquele que não murmura com sua língua; não faz mal ao seu companheiro, nem aceita insulto contra seu próximo.
verses.en_web: He who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
verses.en_bbe: Whose tongue is not false, who does no evil to his friend, and does not take away the good name of his neighbour;

verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.pt: Em seus olhos despreza à pessoa que é digna de reprovação, mas honra aos que temem ao SENHOR; mantém seu juramento até sob seu próprio prejuízo, e não muda.
verses.en_web: In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
verses.en_bbe: Who gives honour to those who have the fear of the Lord, turning away from him who has not the Lord's approval. He who takes an oath against himself, and makes no change.

verses.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.pt: Tal pessoa não empresta seu dinheiro com juros; nem aceita suborno contra o inocente; quem faz isto, nunca se abalará. Cântico de Davi:
verses.en_web: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
verses.en_bbe: He who does not put out his money at interest, or for payment give false decisions against men who have done no wrong. He who does these things will never be moved.
